what: the harvest failed 27 times when stars landed while it worked: its guard - rebase and retry - needed a name to sign with, given only to the first commit, so the guard crashed on the very event it was for
countermeasure: the name set for the repository, so a rebase signs too; proven by its own event - a collision staged on the lab against a throwaway repository: the old step fails as it did, the new one rebases and lands both Then, 2026-11-12 19:40: the guard met a harder collision - the landed change had touched the same data file - and the rebase stopped on the conflict. The data is observed whole each time, and the later observation is the fresher, so on a collision the harvest's own data wins (rebase -X theirs; nothing but the harvest writes data/). Proven against a staged collision on the same file: the step as it was fails, the new one lands its data and keeps the other change.
